energy.quantity: Runner corrected_energy_rel_change for E_Newtonian+U_GR,pot relative to the common t=0 corrected energy.
energy.trend: Unweighted ordinary least-squares slope after centering time; report slope per year and accumulated fitted change over 1 Myr.

comparison_definitions.matching: Match all 10001 rows by exact sample index and exact time; no interpolation.

mercury_perihelion_fit.fit: Unweighted ordinary least squares after centering time at its arithmetic mean.
mercury_perihelion_fit.unwrapping: numpy.unwrap with period 2*pi over the complete matched history

orbital_elements.semimajor_axis_relative_denominator: For each pair/body, max(abs(mean(a_left(t0),a_right(t0))),1e-12 AU), fixed for the full history.

comparison_definitions.physical_frame: Barycentric ICRF Cartesian state stored by the runner.

physical_scaling.pair_body_rms: sqrt(mean(square(sample_body_vector))) over all matched samples and six components for one body
physical_scaling.pair_global_rms: sqrt(mean(square(sample_body_vector))) over all matched samples, real bodies, and six components

tangent.direction_cosine: dot(v_left,v_right)/(norm(v_left)*norm(v_right)) for each matched full-system first-variation vector.
tangent.scaling: Use the same AU and AU/JulianYear component scales as the physical state.

next_action: Do not request a 0.125-day lane. First recompute corrected energy epoch-by-epoch from the existing 0.5-day and new 0.25-day state artifacts using compensated or extended-precision summation and compare it with recorded telemetry.
